Levels.B: SE SFO, SE VFT, SE VOB, ME SFO, ME VFT, ME VOB

Levels.F: ME SFO, ME VOB, ME VFT, SE SFO, SE VOB, SE VFT

note.Description: Participant-level annotations describing data completeness and potential issues.

Levels.complete: All BOLD runs and physiological data are available.
Levels.incomplete: Some data are missing (BOLD runs or physiological data).
